_comment: Build-time settings. catalogUrl is where CI publishes the profile catalog (.github/workflows/profiles.yml); its origin becomes the extension's host permission. Empty until the catalog is published (catalogUrlWhenPublished): only the profiles shipped with the extension are used and no request fails. reportUrl: the report worker (tools/report-worker); empty: only Copy report. fallbackProfiles: vendors shipped per slicer. supportedModels: printer_model names offered in the printer picker: only printers tested by converting and slicing real projects (.notes/PROGRESO.md); printers saved earlier keep working. makerworldOrigins: sites where the MakerWorld integration runs (content scripts and the bridge page). versionName: what Chrome shows next to the version. sourceUrl, privacyUrl: links in the footer of the options page.
